name: Primed Sure Footed
description: Your Helldiver is never knocked down or ragdolled. Hits still make you flinch and push you back. With Extra Boosters installed, it works as the Primed Sure Footed booster: only while the booster is in your squad. Settings in primed-sure-footed.ini. Hit research from Helldiver Survival Rework by enochlophobianumerophobia (MIT).
